title: Palcheck §8 routed legs (d)+(e) index pipe_congestion without the testing_lvl_ok guard the other legs use
detail: When the fixture premise fails (ok_ps false, e.g. topology_apply_edit errors, or found_bi false after a packing change), the resize at 1374 is skipped but the unguarded (d)+(e) block still writes pipe_congestion[ps8] — out-of-bounds when ps8 >= len, panicking palcheck instead of a counted check failure.
recommended_fix: Wrap the (d)+(e) block body in the same `if testing_lvl_ok {` guard used by legs (a)-(c), so a failed fixture premise degrades to the failed premise check, not a bounds panic.
